title: 把满意的 Skill 结果沉淀为官网案例
titleEn: Turn an accepted Skill result into a website case
description: 用户提出一个可重复的收尾动作：某个 Skill 的结果获得明确认可后，使用独立 Skill 把真实 Input → Prompt → Output 写入案例，并把公开目标同步到官网。
descriptionEn: The user requested a repeatable closeout step that records an explicitly accepted Skill result as truthful evidence and syncs public targets to the official site.

items: 现有 LovStudio Skill Card 与 cases/cases.json 契约
官网从公开 Skill 仓库读取案例并按 skill-cases 标签缓存的真实链路
用户明确要求仅在结果不错时收录，并同步官网

prompt: 创建 skill-add-case：每次调用某个 Skill 后，如果结果不错，就把该 case 增加到使用案例中，并同步到官网。

items: 一个可本地安装的 lov-skill-add-case 单 Skill
原子写入、隐私检查、重复检测与 SHA-256 证据指纹 CLI
公开 cases.json 与 LovStudio 详情页双回读验证 CLI
Creator 上游与 Publisher 下游的明确原子交接
GitHub v0.1.0 Release 与 LovStudio 官网 live-verified 详情页

evidence.method: Created from the user's direct product request; source validation, deterministic success and failure checks, GitHub v0.1.0 Release, catalog CI, public raw JSON, and the LovStudio detail page were verified.
evidence.privacy: The case contains only the public product request and reusable contracts; no transcript body, credential, or private absolute path is included.
